messages:
ava: Quick design review request — updated welcome flow: top banner + sample-project cards + a lightweight setup checklist. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/WelcomeFlow-v2 (comments invited). Main asks: contrast, keyboard/accessibility, copy tweaks, and whether checklist should be inline under cards or a persistent pill. Screenshots pasted below.
sasha: Quick look — spacing and hierarchy feel much better. One thing: primary CTA 'Try sample' on purple gradient fails WCAG AA for small text. Recommend white text with 16px semibold or darken gradient by ~8%. :exclamation:
miguel: Accessibility nit: keyboard focus currently jumps to the bottom 'dismiss' checkbox before cards. Focus order should be: banner CTA -> first card -> card actions -> checklist. Also add aria-live on progress updates so screen readers hear changes.
priya: Copy suggestions: change 'Try sample' -> 'Launch sample project' (clarifies action). Replace checklist step 'Connect keys' with 'Add API key' to avoid internal jargon. Also shorten long descriptions on cards to one sentence.
ben_eng: Implementation notes: the responsive 3-up card grid is ok but lazy-loading images causes layout shift. Reserve image aspect ratio or CSS aspect-box. For the inline checklist option, we can persist progress in localStorage and sync to user profile on first auth. Also note: sample projects for private deployments need to avoid hosted API calls.
sasha: UX variant idea: persistent small progress pill in the console header (top-right) showing '1/4 setup complete' — unobtrusive and reduces modals. Click expands a compact checklist. Thoughts? :bulb:
ava: (typo in my last message, meant ava) — I like the pill. We should A/B test pill vs inline checklist. Metric: time-to-first-API-call + % completing sample project within 7 days. Can product ops add those?
priya: On copy variants for A/B: A) 'Get started with a sample project' B) 'Launch a ready-made app' C) 'Explore demo projects'. My pick is A and C for initial test.
miguel: I vote A + C as well. B reads like we ship a separate app which could confuse.
ben_eng: Edge case: allow toggling 'Use local deployment' on sample cards for Redwood Private customers so demos run without calling hosted endpoints. That requires adding a boolean to sample metadata.
design-bot: Heads up — please add an accessibility checklist to the Figma file and tag @sasha. Use /design-checklist template in #design for guidance.
ava: Thanks everyone — I'll schedule a 30m review tomorrow at 10:30am PT. I'll add Linear tasks for: 1) CTA contrast fix, 2) focus order fix, 3) copy updates, 4) header pill A/B, 5) private-deploy toggle. Notes attached below.``
localStorage snippet we discussed:
```js
localStorage.setItem('onboard_v2_progress', JSON.stringify({stepsCompleted: 1, timestamp: Date.now()}))
```
miguel: LGTM. One last thing — add alt text for sample images (e.g., 'Screenshot of blog summarizer demo') and small aria-labels for card action buttons.
ava: Perfect — I'll post updated mocks before the review. Thanks :thumbsup:
